record.question: Mizoram was recently (May 20, 2025) officially declared as India's first fully literate state under the ULLAS initiative with literacy rate of
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation:
The Ministry of Education’s 20 May 2025 release records Mizoram’s full-literacy declaration and reports a 98.20% literacy rate in the 2023–24 Periodic Labour Force Survey. It separately says the Ministry treats a rate above 95% as equivalent to full literacy. The question’s 98.2% is the survey rate, not the administrative threshold or a claim of 100% literacy.

Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2130080&lang=1&reg=3
